dialogue.origin: おはようございます。承認遅くなって申し訳ありません。お時間になりましたらはじます。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Good morning. I apologize for the delay in accepting the session. We'll begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to speaking with you.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、承認ありがとうございます。どうぞ、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Not at all, thank you for accepting my request. I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.origin: こんにちわ、相談員です。よろしくお願い致します。まず初めに年齢と性別、今日の相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 中2 女子
dialogue.content: I'm a second-year junior high school girl.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくないのですね。今夏休みですか？
dialogue.content: So you don't want to go to school. Is it summer vacation right now?

dialogue.origin: 今日始業式だった
dialogue.content: The opening ceremony for the new term was today.

dialogue.origin: 今日から学校だったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so school started today.

dialogue.origin: いけなかった
dialogue.content: I couldn't go.

dialogue.origin: 行けなかった・・・
dialogue.content: You couldn't go...

dialogue.origin: いかなかった理由は何か話せますか？
dialogue.content: Would you be able to talk about why you didn’t go?

dialogue.origin: お腹が痛くて
dialogue.content: My stomach hurt.

dialogue.origin: お腹今は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Is your stomach okay now?

dialogue.origin: 今も少し痛い
dialogue.content: It still hurts a little.

dialogue.origin: それは辛いですね。
dialogue.content: That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: お腹の痛みはどんな時になりますか？
dialogue.content: When does your stomach start to hurt?

dialogue.origin: 夜寝る前とか朝起きた時
dialogue.content: Like before going to bed at night or when I wake up in the morning.

dialogue.origin: 寝る前も痛いと寝るときも辛いですね。
dialogue.content: If it hurts before bed, falling asleep must be difficult too.

dialogue.origin: あんまり寝れない
dialogue.content: I can't sleep very well.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。きついですよね。昨夜も眠れなかったのではないですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds really difficult. You probably couldn't sleep last night either, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 朝は学校に行く時間に起きることはできましたか？
dialogue.content: Were you able to get up at the time you needed to go to school this morning?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 眠れなかったけど、朝は起きれたのですね。よく頑張りましたね。でも学校に行けなかった。
dialogue.content: Even though you couldn’t sleep, you managed to get up in the morning. That's great effort. But you couldn’t go to school.

dialogue.origin: 起きれたっていうか、何度も起きちゃって
dialogue.content: Well, it wasn't so much that I got up, as that I kept waking up.

dialogue.origin: そんなに眠れなかったのですね。何度も起きるほど。お腹が痛いだけじゃはなくてなにかあるのかなと感じます。お話できますか？
dialogue.content: So you really couldn't sleep well, waking up that many times. I feel like there might be something more than just a stomachache. Would you be willing to talk about it?

dialogue.origin: はい、うまく話せるかわからないですけど
dialogue.content: Yes, though I’m not sure I can explain it well.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: That’s okay.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行くのが怖いです
dialogue.content: I’m scared to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 怖いと感じることが有ったのですね。
dialogue.content: So something happened that made you feel scared.

dialogue.origin: はい、中1の時にいじめられて
dialogue.content: Yes, I was bullied in my first year of junior high.

dialogue.origin: 学校にいくのが怖くなりました
dialogue.content: It made me scared to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。学校に行けなくなったのはその頃からですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is that when you started being unable to go to school?

dialogue.origin: 1学期は学校行けてました。
dialogue.content: I was able to go to school during the first semester.

dialogue.origin: その時は怖くなかったですか？
dialogue.content: Weren’t you scared then?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: No, I wasn't.

dialogue.origin: 一年生の時いじめを受けて怖くなったけど行けていた。一学期も行けていた。でも二学期が始まる今日は行けなかった、と言う事ですね。
dialogue.content: So, you were bullied in your first year and became scared, but you were still able to go. You were also able to go during the first semester. But today, when the second semester was supposed to start, you couldn't go. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 昨夜は眠れなかったし今日はお腹が痛いし何があったのでしょうね。
dialogue.content: You couldn't sleep last night, and your stomach hurts today... I wonder what could have happened.

dialogue.origin: 分からない
dialogue.content: I don’t know.

dialogue.origin: 夏休みはどんな風に過ごしましたか？特に変わったことはありませんでしたか？
dialogue.content: How did you spend your summer vacation? Did anything unusual happen?

dialogue.origin: なかったです
dialogue.content: No, nothing.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、ありがとうございます。なぜ行けなかったか自分でも分からない。でも学校に行くのが怖いと感じているのですよね。怖いをもう少し詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: I see, thank you. So you don't know yourself why you couldn’t go. But you do feel scared about going to school. Could you tell me a bit more about what feels scary?

dialogue.origin: 毎日暑いのが嫌汗をかくので
dialogue.content: I hate how hot it is every day because it makes me sweat.

dialogue.origin: 確かにとても暑いですね。暑すぎだと思います。汗をかくのが怖いですか？
dialogue.content: It certainly is very hot. I think it's too hot. Are you scared of sweating?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: これだけ暑いとみんな汗をかいてると思いますが、あなたはどうして怖いと思うのですか？なにかありましたか？
dialogue.content: In weather this hot, I imagine everyone is sweating. What makes it feel scary for you? Did something happen?

dialogue.origin: わたしは太っているので、みんなよりも匂いが出るのが怖いです
dialogue.content: I'm overweight, so I'm scared that I might smell more than everyone else.

dialogue.origin: 匂い？何か言われたことがあるのですか？
dialogue.content: Smell? Has someone said something to you about it?

dialogue.origin: 臭いって言われたことがあって
dialogue.content: I've been told that I stink before.

dialogue.origin: それは辛い経験をしましたね。怖くなる原因かもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: That must have been a painful experience. It might be the reason you're scared.

dialogue.origin: はい、怖いんです
dialogue.content: Yes, I’m scared.

dialogue.origin: 確かに怖くなりますよね。他にも言われたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, that would make anyone scared. Has anything else been said?

dialogue.origin: いや、それだけ
dialogue.content: No, just that.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです。でもその一言が頭から離れないのでしょうね。
dialogue.content: I’m relieved to hear it wasn’t more than that. But that one comment must be stuck in your mind.

dialogue.origin: どうやったら学校にいけますか？
dialogue.content: How can I get myself to go to school?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。今日学校に行けなかった自分をどんな風に感じていますか？
dialogue.content: Let me see. How do you feel about yourself for not being able to go to school today?

dialogue.origin: また汗をかいて臭いって言われたら嫌だなって思って、そんなことを考えていると、お腹が痛くなって、行けなかったです
dialogue.content: I was thinking about how I wouldn't want to be told I smell bad again if I sweat, and as I was thinking about that, my stomach started to hurt, and I couldn't go.

dialogue.origin: 汗をかいても楽しい時間は思い出せませんか？色んな出来事があったと思います。
dialogue.content: Can't you remember any fun times, even when you were sweating? I'm sure there have been many different events.

dialogue.origin: あなたには分からないと思います
dialogue.content: I don’t think you would understand.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: お話聞けずごめんなさい。また相談して頂けること祈っています。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I wasn't able to be more helpful. I hope you'll consider reaching out again.

dialogue.origin: （これで終了で大丈夫ですが？）
dialogue.content: (Is it okay to end here?)

dialogue.origin: （カウンセリングできず申し訳ありませんでした。終了でお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry the counseling wasn't successful. Yes, let's end here.)

dialogue.origin: （ロールプレイお疲れ様でした！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for the role-play session!)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。出直します）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I'll reflect on this and try to do better.)

topic.sub: 学校に行きたくない理由についての恐怖感
